chapter_seo_title: Dao Twisted World Ch 70 – The Lake: Ambush in the Reeds
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang chases a lead on the black-robed nuns, but a ferryman’s vanishing act and armed boats in the reeds reveal that some lakes don't just separate lands—they consume them.
og_title: Chapter 70 – The Lake: “Boiled Knife-Cut Noodles or Wonton Soup?”
og_description: Silence. Vanished crew. Weapons in the reeds. The captain is back with a smile and a very bad menu.
